In 2021, the Group developed 37 new energy power stations (mainly for photovoltaic and wind power generation), invested RMB11.48 billion in boosting clean energy supply, representing a year-on-year increase of 43.04%, and recorded a new installed capacity of more than 2,500 MWh. Up to the end of the Reporting Period, the Group managed a total of 87 wind power and photovoltaic projects. The annual power generation capacity of the existing new energy power stations is estimated to be approximately 9.18 million MWh, which can meet the power demand of 3.48 million households, and reduce 7,111,900 tonnes of carbon dioxide emissions every year, meeting the requirements of green development.

In 2021, the Group developed 37 new energy power stations (mainly for photovoltaic and wind power generation), invested RMB11.48 billion in boosting clean energy supply, representing a year-on-year increase of 43.04%, and recorded a new installed capacity of more than 2,500 MWh. Up to the end of the Reporting Period, the Group managed a total of 87 wind power and photovoltaic projects.
